errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени по низходящ ред на големината им, започвайки от най-големия оранжев сектор и завършвайки с най-малкия жълт.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the sectors are visually arranged in descending order of size. However, the sectors in the chart are not arranged in any particular order based on their value. Starting from the top blue slice and moving clockwise, the percentages are 22.1%, 42.6%, 23.5%, and 11.8%, which is not a descending order.
